newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: CA jumps as privatisation looms.
newsitem.headline: CA jumps as privatisation looms.

text.p: Creditanstalt-Bankverein was the top gainer on Vienna's blue-chip ATX index on Thursday as the spectre of an imminent end to the marathon privatisation of Austria's flagship bank loomed.
At 1123 GMT, Creditanstalt's preferred shares were up 3.58 percent at 506.5 schillings, while its ordinary shares were up 2.23 percent at 735. The ATX was up 0.8 percent.
"Any solution to the long drawn out saga is seen over the short term as a positive incentive. But then one's really got to take a close look at what actually comes out," said one trader.
On Wednesday, Die Erste said it was rejoining the consortium around EA-Generali to bid for the state's 70 percent stake of voting shares in Creditanstalt. The deadline for offers is Friday.
Traders see the gap between the ordinary and preferred shares narrowing further.
"The preferred shares are undervalued, but we still have a long way until the privatisation," said another trader.
